exception_message: preformal seal omits a required runner input
root_cause: build_snapshot counted and commit-bound eleven transitive runtime dependencies, but build_audit reconstructed a second direct-only source map; build_seal therefore emitted no runtime_dependency_* entries even though its audit gate reported the closure count.
repair_contract: Use one shared source-binding assembler in build_snapshot and build_audit.
Persist all eleven runtime_dependency_* bindings into the audit and canonical seal.
Keep the runner fail-closed requirement unchanged.
Add a regression test that the persisted-audit binding assembler cannot omit transitive runtime dependencies.
Create a fresh exact-HEAD audit/seal before any second formal attempt.
